Q186.reason: Res ipsa loquitur applies because the elevator was under the owner's exclusive control and a sudden fall ordinarily does not occur without negligence, so the jury decides.

Q187.reason: Selling an ordinary product while merely knowing the buyer will misuse it is generally not accomplice conduct, unlike knowing facilitation of an illegal enterprise.

Q188.reason: The recorded negative covenant runs to successors, and the daughter takes the house by gift with notice, so she is bound and the man can enforce it.
